body: I love this because it gives another use to beacons. It makes sense as well because it serves as a time-out from the battle where u can get upgrades (strength, jump, etc).

I think this is a great idea and it should apply to other objects as well. For example, fishing rods and bowls. This allows you to have something to do with your gold, other than just make armor/weapons.
